o.norm: illegal state: maximal count (2,331) exceeded: evaluations

i.norm: Verifies that the solver aborts once it runs out of allowed function evaluations. The evaluation budget (maxEval) is set to 2331, which is far too small for the solver to converge on sin(x) over the very wide search interval below, so the solver is expected to exhaust its budget and throw.
The solver should report that it exceeded its evaluation budget, e.g.: "illegal state: maximal count (2,331) exceeded: evaluations"
